hook: Jensen Huang's *Villain Arc* after he resigned as NVIDIA CEO
caption:
A full-blown AI thriller.
Creator @rize.imagines imagined what happens next, with Jensen calling Trump after losing his position, Elon Musk taking over Nvidia, and Jensen preparing for his next move.
The 70-second short film uses AI-generated versions of all three, complete with dramatic dialogue, cinematic shots, and an ending that leaves you wanting more.
This is entirely fictional, but the timing couldn't be better.

Follow @neurafeed.ai for daily AI news.
